views.label: Submit and poll
views.note: Called both directly and by parl-worker, which runs this first and feeds the result to parl-detection.

views.label: Claim and compute
views.note: The worker claims one row, keeps the lease alive, then calls the Python sidecar over localhost:50071.

views.label: Inside the worker pod
views.note: The Go container declares no resource limits here, and the sidecar image is pinned to a fixed date tag.

cards.title: Stage one of the PARL fan-out
items: parl-worker runs this first, then passes the result into parl-detection
The front is the standard twenty-line postgres-lro/lro setup
It is also called directly, so it is not exclusively an orchestrated dependency

cards.title: Worker to sidecar
items: Cold start is slow, so the compute call is retried 15 times at 1s intervals
Only codes.Unavailable is retried; any other error fails the work item immediately
Blob IDs become signed URLs because the Python side holds no storage credentials

cards.title: Two drifts worth fixing
items: The Go container declares no resources block at all, so it is unbounded on the node
The sidecar image is pinned to cbctai-tooth-recognition-compute:20250401
parl-detection-worker shares both; parl-worker also declares no resources block

cards.title: Operations
items: LRO duration threshold is 180s under opdoc DIA-025; the worker is DIA-026
The sidecar requests 4500m and 25Gi, matching its 5 CPU and 25Gi limits
